articles.title: North Korea claims it has developed 'AI-piloted' missiles that leave 'no way to avoid' attack after latest sabre-rattling military drill
articles.description: The new technology was trialled around the eastern coastal city of Wonsan early Saturday morning where it flew more than 700km (435 miles), according to South Korea's military.
articles.content:
North Korean leader Kim Jong-Un has reportedly developed 'AI-piloted' missiles that are impossible to escape.
